summary: Body slope, adjusted for nutrition = 0.299 mm/mm
report: Holding larval nutrition fixed in the additive model, each additional mm of body length was associated with 0.299 mm higher mean horn length (95% CI 0.159 to 0.440; p = 7.658e-05). This conditional association is not the same as the unadjusted relationship or proof of causation.
